definitions.explanation: A member of the clergy in Protestant Christianity who leads a congregation, conducts worship services, and provides spiritual guidance. Specifically refers to Protestant ministers, not Catholic priests.

examples.japanese: {牧師|ぼくし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{祈|いの}り→祈り：13732_inori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{捧|ささ}げた→捧げる：02055_sasageru⟧。
⟦{教会|きょうかい}→教会：01387_kyoukai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{牧師|ぼくし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{結婚式|けっこんしき}→結婚式：05493_kekkonshiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}んだ→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧。
examples.english: We asked the church minister to perform our wedding ceremony.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧{牧師|ぼくし}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧たち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{寄|よ}り{添|そ}って→寄り添う：10587_yorisou⟧きた。
examples.english: He has been close to the local community as a pastor for many years.

notes:
USAGE:
Specifically refers to Protestant clergy. For Catholic priests, use ⟦{神父|しんぷ}→神父：17961_shinpu⟧. For Buddhist monks or priests, use ⟦{僧侶|そうりょ}→僧侶：11529_souryo⟧ or ⟦{住職|じゅうしょく}→住職：15520_juushoku⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {牧師|ぼくし}さん (pastor — polite address)
- {牧師|ぼくし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{説教|せっきょう}→説教：14213_sekkyou⟧ (the pastor's sermon)
- {牧師|ぼくし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to become a pastor)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{神父|しんぷ}→神父：17961_shinpu⟧: Catholic priest — used exclusively for Roman Catholic clergy
- {聖職者|せいしょくしゃ}: member of the clergy — general term covering all religious leaders regardless of denomination
